Here’s a polished hire/welcome email from Aanchal that recaps the conversation, outlines expectations, and references the attached materials. Based on your conversation transcript. fileciteturn0file0L1-L1

:::writing{variant="email" id="48271" subject="Welcome to The Luxora Collective"}
Hi [Her Name],

It was so great speaking with you again! Bethany and the team are incredibly excited to officially welcome you into The Luxora Collective family. We really enjoyed getting to know you better and truly feel like your background, energy, and understanding of the aesthetics industry make you a fantastic fit for what we are building.

As discussed on our call, your initial role will focus primarily on setter outreach and relationship building within the med spa and aesthetics space. The goal is to generate warm, qualified conversations and book Revenue Leak Audit calls with our team. We are looking for quality over quantity, and we want every practice introduced to us to feel genuinely supported, educated, and understood.

To recap some of the key details we discussed:

• Commission structure:
  - $29 paid per booked qualified audit appointment
  - $250 additional commission if the client closes
  - Opportunity to transition into a closer role as we continue scaling

• Outreach methods:
  - LinkedIn
  - Instagram DMs
  - Email outreach
  - Phone/networking outreach if comfortable

• Ideal clients:
  - Independent med spa owners
  - Practices typically doing $500K–$2M annually
  - Owners struggling with growth, systems, retention, memberships, conversions, or scaling

• Communication:
  - For now, we’ll keep communication organized via email while Slack is being finalized
  - You’ll always have support available from both Bethany and myself for questions, scripting, objections, or guidance

Attached you will find several onboarding materials and resources to help you get started, including:
- Setter agreement/contract
- Outreach and partnership scripts
- Luxora deliverables overview
- Growth Engine framework
- KPI reference materials
- Appointment booking/tracking information

These materials are simply to help guide and support you. We absolutely want you to personalize conversations naturally in your own voice while keeping messaging professional, warm, and consultative rather than overly “salesy.”

One thing Bethany emphasized that I think is important to repeat: we are building a very tight-knit ecosystem and team culture here at Luxora. Integrity, professionalism, positivity, and genuine relationship-building matter deeply to us. We are looking for people who want to grow long term with the company, and we are very excited about the potential opportunity ahead for you here.

Please review everything thoroughly once received, and if you have any questions at all, never hesitate to reach out. We are here to support you every step of the way.

We are truly excited to have you onboard and cannot wait to get started together!

Welcome to The Luxora Collective.

Warmly,

Aanchal  
The Luxora Collective
:::
